snippet.title: The Seventh Variable - Announcement Trailer - Cyberpunk Tactical RPG
snippet.description:
The Seventh Variable's debut trailer has arrived! Dive into our cyberpunk tactical RPG with:
✨ Squad combat in a neon metropolis
✨ Fate-altering choices for you and your team
✨ A city's future in your hands
Follow our journey!
